nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.text: What if it's dark, so you can't see, so you slip, so you hit your head, so you're knocked out, so the group leaves, so no one finds your body for days?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I really don't think that's likely...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I'll go look with you, okay? Let's just make this quick...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'd keep looking, Morticia. I know Brendan, and you're definitely `not` his type!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, I'd keep looking, Morticia. I know Brendan, and you're definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] his type!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh! And what is his type?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: He likes girls who play video games... Girls who are into horror movies... Girls who have glasses and ponytails and names that rhyme with 'vat'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's awfully specific...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Geez... I'd better not get on her bad side!
The next day, all the students visit the world-famous `Sphere Theater!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The next day, all the students visit the world-famous [b]Sphere Theater![/b]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... It's so cool that I'm actually standing in the theater that Wilford Shlockspeare founded in 1542!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So many great plays performed here... So much history!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, there!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, hi, Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This is pretty amazing, isn't it? Being on the same site where all the original Shlockspeare plays were performed?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know... It's so weird to think that he once stood right there, giving directions for the first production of `Spamlet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know... It's so weird to think that he once stood right there, giving directions for the first production of [color=#3b78e2][i]Spamlet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I didn't know you were a Shlockspeare fan!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I love his stuff... Only the tragedies though!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, have you ever heard the Legend of the `Lost Shlockspeare play?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, have you ever heard the Legend of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Lost Shlockspeare play?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Lost play?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: They say Shlockspeare's best play was lost to time... Hidden somewhere in the basement of the Sphere Theater!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's so cool! Do you want to go look for it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... I'm pretty sure we're supposed to stay with the group...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, come on... Don't you think it'd be cool to...

nodes.prompt: Don't you think it'd be cool to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Don't you think it'd be cool to...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh really? You've got a soft spot for a nerdy guy?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, I never said 'nerdy'... Just, you know, someone who can make me laugh, someone I can have a real conversation with!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, I `totally` know what you mean. My boyfriend back home is sooo dumb... He doesn't believe that Europe is one country!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] know what you mean. My boyfriend back home is sooo dumb... He doesn't believe that Europe is one country!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh, Amanda, I hate to break it to you...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If Europe wasn't a country, how could it have its own money?!
Amanda proudly waves a stack of Euros around. Kat and Dinah quickly ignore her.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: So who do you like? Anyone in particular?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um, not really... That Brendan guy seems kind of nice, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So you're mostly into looks, huh? That's not what I would've expected!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh! Nothing! It's just... You know... You look... You are... That is... Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Je m'apelle Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: I think what she was trying to say, before it fried her brain, was that your looks are... Unconventional.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, maybe I'm attracted to unconventional-looking guys!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Like who?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh, I dunno... I guess I think that Brendan guy is kind of cute...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, so you like bad boys, huh? I bet there are a lot of those in Europe!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know! We should go hit on guys in the sketchiest, shadiest, sleaziest places we can!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure that's the best idea...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, don't worry about us getting hurt or anything. My daddy's made sure that there are disguised agents watching me wherever I go!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Really?
On the other side of the room, a potted plant coughs uncomfortably.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess what I was trying to say was that I like guys who are, you know, complicated... Maybe a little unique.

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Like who?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... I think that Brendan guy is kind of interesting...
Meanwhile, in the girls' hotel room...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: This is so exciting! I can't believe we're really in England!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know, right? There are so many fun things to do! I can't wait to go shopping...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Or see the museums...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or go shopping...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Or see some old ruins...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or go shopping!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: You've kind of got a one-track mind...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooo! Do you think we'll get to meet King Arthur?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I really wish Linda could've made it... She was really excited to go...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm just so excited! The three of us are gonna have a great time!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Yeah, and the guys on the trip aren't all that bad either!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Forget the guys on the trip. I want to meet some super hot Euro stud!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I thought you had a boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Accent rule! If he's got an accent, it doesn't count as cheating!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's a rule at all...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Well, how about you, Dinah? What kind of guy are you into?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I like...

nodes.prompt: What kind of guy are you into?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What kind of guy are you into?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, you go to him... And you say 'Hey, Brendan!'... And then you tell him how you feel!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That was... Surprisingly lucid! Thanks, Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Go on! Do it right now! Then you guys can have a good time at the club together!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aw, you don't have to worry about that! You're totally cute! No one would ever say no to you!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Unless, I guess, they don't like your makeup... Or they don't like your hair... Or they think you're a vampire...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're not a vampire, are you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, Amanda, I'm not a vampire. And thanks for the confidence boost.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, look. Brendan seems like a nice guy, and I'm sure he'd like a girl like you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But with things like this, you've got to move fast! You never know when some other girl is just gonna swoop in and steal him!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But what do I do?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What do you mean you don't know how? You've asked out guys before, right?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Right?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, uh, the funny thing is...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You haven't? He's the first?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: This just gets cuter and cuter!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm glad I could make you happy... But I still don't know how to ask him out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So I don't want to interrupt this lovefest or anything... But do you two wanna go grab some grub?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Unfortunately, Mr. Macho American, I have no time now to be grabbing grubs... I must get to the airport in thirty minutes!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Airport? Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am on a trip of Europe, my silly man of muscles! My next stop is Milan, Italy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! That's where we're going too!
Astrid leans in and runs her fingers down Hector's face.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Then perhaps... I shall see you there!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Fare thee well!
Astrid runs off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Dude, that girl is `crazy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude, that girl is [color=#e23b3b][i]crazy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... `Crazy awesome!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#e23b3b][i]Crazy awesome![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The next night, in a hotel room in Milan... Dinah paces around anxiously!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just don't know what to do! I really like Brendan... But I don't know how to ask a guy out! I've never done it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What are you supposed to do? Buy him a gift? Run up and make out with him?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... What if he says no?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah, you coming? Most of us are going to try to get into this Italian club down the street...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, I think I'm just going to stay in for the night... I'm, uh, not into clubs.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute... Are you upset about something? You don't seem like yourself.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's wrong? You can tell me! I'm a `great` listener!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's wrong? You can tell me! I'm a [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] listener!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... To be totally honest... I'm nervous about seeing Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think I have a pretty big crush on him... But I really don't know how to act on it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... My... Gosh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That is `so cute!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]so cute![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No offense, but I totally didn't think you were the kind of girl who, you know, got crushes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I figured you, like, cast love spells or dated werewolves or something!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No... I get crushes, the same as anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, that means... You should just ask him out, same as anyone else!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But...

nodes.prompt: You should just ask him out!

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: You should just ask him out!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, so you are a tourist like me? Traveling the European continent in search of adventure and passion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm on a class trip... But I really don't want to be here!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I just don't really like travelling.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You do not like to travel? That is terrible!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: In my village, there is a saying: 'A man who does not like to travel is like a cat with his head stuck in a jar of pickles...'

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: 'Both of them are very stupid.'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But in truth, I do not see stupidity in your eyes! I see a powerful spirit, caged by your weak flesh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, say no more! I knew it just looking at you!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are a wandering dreamer, a lover adrift in a sea of swirling passions!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I am?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I can sense it all around you... The letters inked in crimson blood... The groping of hands in a storm of sand and dust!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, is this, like, a cultural thing? Because I have no idea what you're talking about!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You will, my mop-haired rabbit. You will.
Meanwhile, in an arcade in the nearby city of Freiburg...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, who knew? This place has actually got a pretty bumping arcade! I haven't seen some of these games in forever!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, they're okay... But who cares about the games? Check out all the hotties!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector... Not again...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, man. I know we struck out in the theater... But that was some sort of freak situation! That girl was crazy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've been beefing up on my German pick-up lines, and there's no way we're going back to our hotel room without two pretty Frauleins in tow!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Ugh, you two are overgrown children, you know that?

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Is that a vintage `Dinosaur Space Cowboy Marines` arcade console? I haven't seen one since I was eight!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! Is that a vintage [color=#3b78e2][i]Dinosaur Space Cowboy Marines[/i][/color] arcade console? I haven't seen one since I was eight!

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: SQUEEEEEEEEEE!
Kat runs off.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did you understand a word she just said?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, dude. If you want to get your fro lion or whatever, you can be my guest. But I'm not hitting on anyone, okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm serious, Hector. I just want to relax and get this stupid trip over with.
Suddenly, a tall and beautiful girl steps towards the two guys.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah, excuse me... Do you two know where I might find the nearest currency exchange?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why hello there, my lovely German crumpet! Ahem, ahem...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ihre Haut sieht wie ein Block des alten Kases aus?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Um, first of all, I'm Norwegian, not German... And second of all, you just told me I have skin like an old block of cheese!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I... I did...?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean... In America, that's the finest compliment you can give a lady! Girl, your skin is some serious aged cheddar!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ha ha. Good try, American boy. You're just cute enough that you almost convinced me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, hey, I'll take it. You think I'm cute, huh?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes, I do... But not as cute as your dark, mysterious friend!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean... Me?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: He has the brooding intensity of a tormented soul... The barely hidden suffering of a vessel lost in a thundering storm...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Tell me, dark one... What torments you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I'm upset about...
Confused and scared, the bear runs off!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I... I did it! I beat up a bear!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You... You saved me! I can't thank you enough!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I mean... I just did what I had to!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, that... That was the bravest thing I've ever seen anyone do!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I know I should be humble... But I just beat up a bear! I'm awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... I think I have a crush on Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know this! We're supposed to make loud noises to scare it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Roar! Boom! Bang!

nodes.speaker: Mama Bear
nodes.text: GRRRRRRRR!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Not loud enough! We've got to be louder! Louder!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: All right, everyone... One... Two... Three...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: RAAAAAAAARRRRRR!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: RAAAAAAAARRRRRR!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: RAAAAAAAARRRRRR!

nodes.speaker: Mama Bear
nodes.text: Whimper!
The black bear turns and runs off!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: We did it! We did it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's gone!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was the biggest teddy bear I've ever seen! `I want it!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That was the biggest teddy bear I've ever seen! [color=#3b78e2][i]I want it![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm calling my daddy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Phew... That was pretty scary!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Scary? That was `terrifying!` And we all would've been bear food if it wasn't for your quick thinking! How'd you know what to do?
nodes.text_bbcode: Scary? That was [color=#e23b3b][i]terrifying![/i][/color] And we all would've been bear food if it wasn't for your quick thinking! How'd you know what to do?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You'll probably never believe me... But I used to be in the 'Girl Sprouts'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You? Ha ha ha! You're right, I don't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, it's true!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Did you wear an all-black jumper? Did you get a merit badge for 'intense glaring'?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ha ha ha. Real funny!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I've never met anyone like you, Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You know what, Brendan? I've never met anyone like you either!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh... I think I have a crush on Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you sure? I thought you weren't supposed to run...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Just trust me, Brendan!
Dinah starts to run away...
But trips on a root and falls down!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Owwwww!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't watch!
The bear rears up, about to attack Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No!!!
Brendan dives forward, leaping over Dinah... And smacks the bear across the face with his camera!
After a long day of traveling, the group makes it to Germany! The first stop on their sight-seeing tour is the Black Forest!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, look here! Our last visit to a historical site was less than ideal... So I'm expecting you all to be on your best behavior!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: That means you, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes, Ms. Prez!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now then. Feel free to explore the forest or check out the nearby city. We'll meet up back here in three hours!
And so, a little while later, Brendan and Dinah wander down towards a beautiful lake!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, it really is pretty here, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah! Thanks for coming with me... I knew the others would just want to hang out in the city!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What do they know, right? And hey, at least we managed to ditch Kat!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Never mind.
Suddenly, Amanda bursts through the bushes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! Did you see a teddy bear come running through here?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was walking in the woods when I saw this super cute teddy bear, but when I tried to pick it up, it ran away!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Did... Did you chase a bear cub?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Guys...
A huge black bear lumbers toward the group!

nodes.speaker: Mama Bear
nodes.text: Grrrrrrrrrr!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't let her bite you, or you'll turn into a bear too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This doesn't even make sense! Germany doesn't have black bears! I read about it in my travel book!

nodes.speaker: Mama Bear
nodes.text: `Raaaaaaaawr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Raaaaaaaawr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You lied to me, 'Illustrated Guide to Germany'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait... Wait... I remember this... I know what we're supposed to do...

nodes.prompt: I know what we're supposed to do...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I know what we're supposed to do...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Hector! I'm calling her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Your funeral, G.
Howard dials Linda's number.
Ring... Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Hi! I'm not in right now, but leave me a message, and I'll get back to you as soon as I can! Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, hi! Hey! Heya! It's, uh, me... Howard. Howie. H-dog. Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just calling to, uh, see how you're doing. I'm just hanging out... You know how it goes. Kicking it in the old E.U., old-school style.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Annnnnnnnyway, I was just hoping you were feeling better, you know, getting your rest, drinking your fluids, all that good stuff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, well, I gotta get back to, uh, this crazy party we're at. Wish you were here! To party with me. At this party. Wooo party!
Howard hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did... Did I come off as desperate?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Super desperate.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Super `mega` desperate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Super [color=#e23b3b][i]mega[/i][/color] desperate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, you know what? If I call her and she's not there, I'm just going to get more worried.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, she's sick and needs her rest! I don't want to call and get her all worked up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just going to focus on enjoying the night, and that's that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, boss! That's the willful self-rationalization I was looking for! Now get over here and watch this crazy British TV! They show stuff you'd never see back home!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Hector, is it really that bad to just tell a girl how you feel? You know, if you really like her?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, it's totally fine... If you're into being a doormat!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I'm a little worried about what my parents will say... But they'll probably just be happy I was spending time with a cute girl!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... That might've come out wrong...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay. Just this once, I'll let it slide!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Unbelievable! Simply unbelievable! What were you three thinking? Breaking off from the tour group to sneak around in a basement?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Ms. Prez...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It won't happen again...

nodes.speaker: Kat
nodes.text: It was all Dinah's fault! She made us go down there!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: I don't care whose fault it was! You're all restricted to your hotel rooms tonight!
A security guard rushes out of the theater and approaches the group.

nodes.speaker: Officer Montesquieu
nodes.text: Um, pardon me... Are you Ms. Prez of the American tour group, by any chance?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Um, yes. Yes, I am.

nodes.speaker: Officer Montesquieu
nodes.text: Well, you might want to know that two of your students have been harassing our info girl with nonsensical pick-up lines.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Howard... Hector... Grr...

nodes.speaker: Officer Montesquieu
nodes.text: In addition, we've had to lock up an American girl who refused to leave our gift shop... The only thing she'll say is 'Je m'apelle Amanda.'

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Sigh... Take me to the holding room...
